verdict.rationale: Wrike documents its own ability to connect the workspace to other apps and to run two-way syncs with 22 named integrated systems such as Jira and GitHub. The evidence never mentions an app marketplace or integration directory, and nothing supports a catalog of thousands of tools; the only figure given is 22. Missing for 10: a documented app marketplace, evidence of thousands of available integrations, independent corroboration of breadth.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can connect my workspace to thousands of third-party tools via an app marketplace

citations.quote: Connect Wrike to your apps, build no-code automations, and run end-to-end workflows from one secure platform.
Set up two-way syncs between your Wrike account and 22 integrated systems, including Jira, GitHub, and more.
